topic.name: 全球治理与外交
topic.description: 追踪国际组织、峰会、制裁、谈判与地缘关系变化
topic.query: diplomacy international relations summit sanctions United Nations

overview: 今日专题“全球治理与外交”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Trump downplays US outages and Nvidia security concerns in remarks before China summit – as it happened
items.summary: This live blog is now closed. Follow our live coverage of the Asia-Pacific economic cooperation summit Sign up for US breaking News email Linked to that, the White House held a briefing call with several reporters today about the wave of tech outages affecting several industries. CNN reported that officials said the administration underscored that what has happened is not as a result of cyber-attacks but due to the “hardening and upgrading of our systems”, including “systems being patched, hardware being applied”. Per CNN, an official added: “It’s good the American people are focused on the need to upgrade our legacy systems.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普在对华峰会前淡化美国网络中断及英伟达安全担忧
items.summaryZh: 白宫官员表示，近期影响多个行业的科技中断并非网络攻击所致，而是系统升级和硬件维护的结果。政府强调此次事件凸显了升级美国老旧系统的必要性。
items.whyImportant: 政府对基础设施稳定性的回应旨在缓解市场对关键技术领域安全漏洞的恐慌。

items.title: Apec brings world leaders and probably 2 ‘nuclear briefcases’ to Shenzhen
items.summary: World leaders have descended on the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen for the Apec summit, and two of them likely brought their “nuclear button” with them. The United States president’s famous briefcase – nicknamed the “nuclear football” – has yet to be sighted in the Chinese city. The so-called emergency satchel is actually a bulky black briefcase containing war plans and it can be used to send nuclear orders to the Pentagon. But the Russian equivalent, known as the Cheget, made an unexpected...
items.titleZh: APEC峰会在深圳召开，世界领导人或携带两只“核手提箱”
items.summaryZh: 各国领导人齐聚深圳参加APEC峰会，据称美俄领导人可能随身携带了核指挥控制系统。虽然美国总统的“核足球”尚未被目击，但俄罗斯的“切格特”核手提箱已被发现。
items.whyImportant: 核指挥系统的随行体现了当前大国之间高度紧张的战略互信状态。

items.title: As talks with Xi get under way, Trump asks China to do more for US farmers
items.summary: US President Donald Trump says he will press China on agricultural purchases as talks begin with his counterpart Xi Jinping on Thursday. The request on the sidelines of the Apec summit in Shenzhen comes as Trump stresses that the two leaders have made their relationship “fair”. In his opening remarks of their meeting, Trump said he would ask Xi to “do some more for our farmers”, citing China’s “insatiable appetite”. He also cited the Ukraine war, energy security and Iran in his comments. He...
items.titleZh: 随着与习近平的会谈开始，特朗普要求中国为美国农民做更多贡献
items.summaryZh: 特朗普在APEC峰会期间表示，将敦促中国增加对美国农产品的采购。他强调双方关系已趋于公平，并同时提及了乌克兰战争、能源安全及伊朗问题。
items.whyImportant: 贸易议题仍是中美双边关系中的核心筹码，直接影响美国国内农业利益集团的诉求。

items.title: US launched unarmed ICBM test hours before Trump’s Air Force One landed in China
items.summary: The United States conducted an intercontinental ballistic missile test less than two hours before President Donald Trump landed in China on Wednesday for the Apec summit and a high-stakes trilateral meeting with his Chinese and Russian counterparts. According to a statement from the US Air Force Global Strike Command, an unarmed Minuteman III missile was launched at 11.01pm Pacific Time on Tuesday from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, in a test designated Glory Trip 257. The launch...
items.titleZh: 美国在特朗普抵达中国前数小时试射了一枚未装弹头的洲际弹道导弹
items.summaryZh: 美国空军全球打击司令部在特朗普抵达中国参加APEC峰会前不到两小时，从加州范登堡太空军基地试射了一枚“民兵-3”型洲际弹道导弹。此次代号为“光荣之旅257”的测试旨在验证导弹系统的可靠性。
items.whyImportant: 在敏感外交时刻进行军事威慑展示，反映了美国在处理大国关系时采取的“实力外交”策略。

items.title: Elon Musk claims ‘I’m not Maga’ and says he regrets vast sums to back Republicans
items.summary: Musk, who aligned with Trump and was frequent White House guest, says he feels ‘pretty foolish’ about record midterm spending Elon Musk denied being Maga on Wednesday, despite aligning himself intensely with Donald Trump’s Make America Great Again movement since 2024. “I’m not Maga,” the world’s richest person told the New York Times Dealbook summit, which he attended via video call from China, where he is one of several US business leaders who have accompanied Trump on his trip to Asia. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克声称“我不是MAGA”，并表示后悔为支持共和党投入巨资
items.summaryZh: 作为特朗普的盟友，马斯克在出席中国峰会期间通过视频连线表示，自己并非“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动的支持者。他对自己在中期选举中的巨额投入感到后悔。
items.whyImportant: 作为关键的商业领袖，马斯克与特朗普政治阵营的距离变化可能影响未来美国政商关系的走向。

items.title: Apec summit finds Marco Rubio again admiring Chinese architecture
items.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio was once again generous in his admiration for China’s grand architecture, this time at the Apec summit’s welcome dinner ahead of Thursday’s main meeting. At the Shenzhen International Communication Centre on Wednesday night, Chinese President Xi Jinping and first lady Peng Liyuan welcomed US President Donald Trump and other leaders to the southern tech hub. A video showed Rubio speaking to China’s ambassador to the United States, Xie Feng, and US ambassador to...
items.titleZh: APEC峰会上，马尔科·鲁比奥再次对中国建筑表示赞赏
items.summaryZh: 美国国务卿鲁比奥在APEC欢迎晚宴上，再次表达了对中国宏伟建筑的赞赏。他在深圳国际交流中心与中国驻美大使谢锋进行了交流。
items.whyImportant: 高层官员在外交场合的礼节性互动，在一定程度上为紧张的双边关系提供了缓和的沟通渠道。

items.title: Xi-Trump ties tested as calls grow in Washington for tougher China policy
items.summary: The personal rapport between US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping is being put to its sternest test yet amid growing congressional pressure over AI chip curbs and broader calls in Washington for a more assertive policy on China, according to experts. The two leaders are set to hold formal talks on Thursday on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit in Shenzhen. While Trump may want to preserve a cordial rapport with Xi and a tactical thaw between...
items.titleZh: 华盛顿对华强硬政策呼声高涨，习特关系面临考验
items.summaryZh: 随着美国国会就人工智能芯片限制及对华强硬政策施压，特朗普与习近平的个人关系正面临严峻考验。两国领导人计划在深圳APEC峰会期间举行正式会谈。
items.whyImportant: 美中两国在关键技术和外交政策上的分歧加剧，可能影响两国领导人试图维持的战术性缓和关系。

items.title: Meet Monica Crowley, the US protocol chief orchestrating Trump’s Apec optics
items.summary: When Chinese President Xi Jinping broke decades of diplomatic precedent to greet US President Donald Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen on Wednesday, cameras caught a woman in a striking yellow dress standing a few steps from the two leaders. That ever-present figure is Monica Crowley, the 35th chief of protocol of the United States. In high-stakes summitry, she is an invisible stage manager responsible for the diplomatic logistics and ceremonial choreography of the US president’s foreign...
items.titleZh: 揭秘莫妮卡·克劳利：策划特朗普深圳APEC外交礼仪的幕后推手
items.summaryZh: 在习近平主席打破外交惯例于深圳机场迎接特朗普总统时，美国礼宾司司长莫妮卡·克劳利出现在现场。作为幕后策划者，她负责处理总统外事活动的物流与礼仪安排。
items.whyImportant: 外交礼仪的细节安排在高级别峰会中具有重要的政治象征意义，反映了美方对此次外交活动的精心筹备。

items.title: US panel urges Congress to punish China over Panama-flagged ship detentions
items.summary: A bipartisan US congressional commission has urged lawmakers to declare China’s detention of hundreds of Panama-flagged ships a form of “economic coercion” and to let the US president respond with sanctions, nearly 10 months after Panama’s Supreme Court stripped a subsidiary of Hong Kong-based CK Hutchison Holdings of its right to run two ports on the Panama Canal. In its annual report to Congress, released on Wednesday, the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission said Beijing had made...
items.titleZh: 美国委员会敦促国会就巴拿马籍船只扣留问题制裁中国
items.summaryZh: 美国国会的一个两党委员会建议将中国扣留数百艘巴拿马籍船只的行为定性为“经济胁迫”，并授权总统实施制裁。此前，巴拿马最高法院曾取消了长江和记实业子公司对巴拿马运河两个港口的经营权。
items.whyImportant: 此举可能加剧美中两国在贸易与地缘政治领域的紧张关系。

items.title: South Korean first lady Kim Hea Kyung’s warmth and style captivate Chinese social media
items.summary: South Korean first lady Kim Hea Kyung has charmed Chinese social media users with her warmth towards ground staff, personal style and affection for her husband – fuelling online “shipping” of Seoul’s first couple. Accompanying South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, Kim arrived in Shenzhen early on Wednesday for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit. Like other visiting dignitaries, Lee and Kim received a red-carpet welcome with an honour guard. More than 100 dancers dressed in white...
items.titleZh: 韩国第一夫人金惠京的亲和力与风采吸引中国社交媒体关注
items.summaryZh: 韩国第一夫人金惠京在陪同李在明总统出席深圳APEC峰会期间，因其对工作人员的亲和态度及个人风采受到中国网民热议。公众对这对韩国政坛夫妇的互动表现出了浓厚兴趣。
items.whyImportant: 第一夫人的外交形象在社交媒体上的积极传播有助于提升韩国在华的软实力。

items.title: Apec leaders suit up with Chinese-style scarves for family photo in Shenzhen
items.summary: Apec leaders were given Chinese-style scarves to wear for the group summit photo on Thursday. It was a pared-back nod to the forum’s tradition of dressing attendees in the host economy’s sartorial heritage. The scarves came in two colours: red and blue. Most leaders, including Chinese President Xi Jinping, opted for red, while US President Donald Trump and his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin wore blue. The hem of each scarf is embroidered with the summit emblem, which features 21 intertwined...
items.titleZh: APEC领导人身着中式围巾拍摄全家福
items.summaryZh: 在深圳APEC峰会上，各国领导人佩戴中式围巾拍摄合影，延续了穿戴东道主民族服饰的传统。围巾分为红蓝两色，习近平主席等多数领导人选择了红色，而特朗普总统和普京总统则选择了蓝色。
items.whyImportant: 这一礼仪安排体现了东道主文化特色，并成为国际媒体观察领导人互动细节的焦点。

items.title: Tammy Shipley was supposed to be monitored in prison. Instead she died after drinking 20L of water
items.summary: If the Aboriginal woman had been checked at regular intervals as required, her ‘excess consumption of water’ would have been prevented, inquest finds • Warning: This article contains images of and references to Indigenous Australians who have died Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The death of an Aboriginal woman who collapsed after drinking at least 20 litres of water in a New South Wales prison cell was preventable and the result of systemic failures, a coroner has found. Tammy Michelle Shipley, 47, died at Silverwater women’s correctional centre on 20 December 2022. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 塔米·希普利本应在狱中接受监管，却因饮用20升水而死亡
items.summaryZh: 验尸官调查发现，原住民女子塔米·希普利在澳大利亚新南威尔士州监狱中因饮用过量水死亡，这本是可以通过定期检查来预防的。调查指出该事件是系统性失职的结果。
items.whyImportant: 此案引发了对监狱管理制度及原住民囚犯人权保障的广泛关注。

items.title: Presidents Xi and Trump talk Iran, Ukraine and ‘special relationship’ at summit
items.summary: This live article is freely available to our registered users. Please log in or create an account. World leaders are gathering in Shenzhen on Thursday for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) plenary, looking for ways to promote trade and investment at a time of rising global uncertainty. Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese are among the leaders...
items.titleZh: 习近平与特朗普在峰会期间讨论伊朗、乌克兰及“特殊关系”
items.summaryZh: 世界领导人齐聚深圳参加APEC全体会议，旨在全球不确定性加剧的背景下探讨贸易与投资合作。中国国家主席习近平、美国总统特朗普、俄罗斯总统普京等领导人出席了此次会议。
items.whyImportant: 大国领导人在峰会期间的直接对话对全球地缘政治走向具有重要影响。

items.titleZh: “这是我的朋友”：特朗普在中国峰会上问候普京的瞬间
items.summaryZh: 在出席中国举办的峰会期间，美国总统特朗普在与俄罗斯总统普京会面时称呼对方为“我的朋友”。这一互动瞬间引发了外界对美俄关系走向的猜测。
items.whyImportant: 美俄领导人在公开场合的互动细节常被视为两国关系风向标。

items.title: After days of travel and diplomacy, Trump seems to nod off during Apec speeches
items.summary: As world leaders start a new day of talks at the Apec summit in Shenzhen, US President Donald Trump was seen seemingly dozing off in his seat. While President Xi Jinping was outlining China’s hopes for the Asia-Pacific, the 80-year-old apparently nodded off, live feed showed. Meanwhile, Russian President Vladimir Putin’s gaze remained fixed on the proceedings, and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Hong Kong’s leader John Lee took notes. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi was seen...
items.titleZh: 经过多日奔波与外交活动，特朗普在APEC演讲期间似乎打起了瞌睡
items.summaryZh: 在深圳APEC峰会期间，80岁的美国总统特朗普在习近平主席发表关于亚太愿景的演讲时，被直播镜头捕捉到疑似打瞌睡。与此同时，其他领导人则在认真听讲或做笔记。
items.whyImportant: 领导人的健康状况与会议表现常成为国际舆论关注的焦点。

items.title: UN intellectual property agency pledges deeper cooperation with Hong Kong
items.summary: The United Nations agency for intellectual property (IP) has pledged to deepen cooperation with Hong Kong on dispute resolution, education and commercialisation as the city’s government plans to expand a pilot scheme for lending backed by intangible assets. Speaking at the Business of IP Asia Forum on Thursday, Shen Changyu, deputy director general of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), said the agency stood ready to help Hong Kong use IP to advance its ambitions in finance,...
items.titleZh: 联合国知识产权机构承诺深化与香港的合作
items.summaryZh: 世界知识产权组织承诺在争议解决、教育及商业化方面深化与香港的合作。此举旨在支持香港利用知识产权推动金融及相关产业的发展。
items.whyImportant: 该合作有助于巩固香港作为国际知识产权贸易中心的地位。

items.title: APEC Live: Trump-Xi-Putin meeting to focus on Ukraine, Iran, AI
items.summary: The unprecedented summit follows Trump's bilateral meetings with China's Xi and Russia's Putin.
items.titleZh: APEC现场：特朗普、习近平与普京的会晤将聚焦乌克兰、伊朗及人工智能
items.summaryZh: 此次史无前例的峰会是在特朗普分别与中国国家主席习近平及俄罗斯总统普京举行双边会谈后召开的。会议重点讨论乌克兰局势、伊朗问题以及人工智能的发展与监管。
items.whyImportant: 此次三方会晤涉及全球地缘政治与科技治理的核心议题，对国际安全格局具有深远影响。

items.title: This is a remarkable diplomatic moment for China's Xi - but it comes with pitfalls
items.summary: The meeting comes with challenges as there are things Xi does not appear keen to discuss with Putin and Trump.
items.titleZh: 这对中国国家主席习近平来说是一个非凡的外交时刻，但也伴随着陷阱
items.summaryZh: 此次峰会充满挑战，因为习近平似乎并不愿意与普京和特朗普讨论某些敏感议题。外交平衡的难度在当前复杂的国际环境下显得尤为突出。
items.whyImportant: 中国在处理大国关系时面临复杂的利益权衡，其外交策略的调整将影响全球战略稳定。

items.title: Peng’s English and Cantonese classics: the Shenzhen Apec details you may have missed

Rare hug and roaring flyover set stage for historic firsts at Apec in Shenzhen It was a day of firsts in Shenzhen on Wednesday when Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted his American counterpart Donald Trump at the city airport, setting up a historic start to the Apec summit. 2. China’s first lady Peng Liyuan lets her...
items.titleZh: 彭丽媛的英语与粤语经典：你可能错过的深圳APEC细节
items.summaryZh: 深圳APEC峰会首日亮点频出，包括习近平主席在机场迎接特朗普总统，以及中国第一夫人彭丽媛的公开活动。这些细节展示了峰会期间的礼宾互动与文化交流。
items.whyImportant: 峰会期间的非正式互动与文化展示是观察大国领导人外交风格及双边关系氛围的重要窗口。

items.title: Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Secures Historic Economic Deals for American Workers and Strengthens America’s Leadership in Asia
items.summary: SUPPORTING AMERICAN JOBS AND STRENGTHENING U.S. DIPLOMATIC LEADERSHIP IN THE INDO-PACIFIC: Today, President Donald J. items.titleZh: 事实清单：特朗普总统为美国工人达成历史性经济协议，并加强美国在亚洲的领导地位
items.summaryZh: 特朗普总统在菲律宾参加东盟峰会期间，宣布了超过170亿美元的商业协议与战略投资。这些举措旨在支持美国就业并巩固美国在印太地区的领导地位。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过经济合作强化美国在印太地区的战略影响力，并向国内展示其外交政策的经济成果。

items.title: China’s Xi greets Putin and Trump at APEC before historic summit
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping greeted Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin at APEC summit.
items.titleZh: 中国国家主席习近平在APEC峰会前会见普京与特朗普
items.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平在深圳APEC峰会期间，分别会见了美国总统特朗普与俄罗斯总统普京。
items.whyImportant: 此次会晤涉及全球三大主要大国领导人，对当前国际地缘政治格局具有重要影响。

items.title: What do Trump, Putin and Xi want from their Shenzhen meeting?
items.summary: The US, Chinese and Russian leaders are to hold their first three-way talks on the sidelines of the APEC summit.
items.titleZh: 特朗普、普京和习近平在深圳会晤中各有什么诉求？
items.summaryZh: 美、中、俄三国领导人将在APEC峰会期间举行首次三方会谈。各方正寻求通过此次会晤推进各自的战略目标。
items.whyImportant: 三方会谈的举行标志着大国博弈进入新阶段，各方的诉求将直接影响全球政治与经济走向。

items.title: Record-breaking rain lashes California’s Bay area as ‘atmospheric river’ arrives
items.summary: Storm expected to move into southern California, with LA residents warned of potential evacuation orders Heavy rain pounded California’s Bay area, with record rainfall in downtown San Francisco and flooding and power outages across the region, as an “atmospheric river” arrived on Wednesday and dumped precipitation across the state. The storm was expected to move into southern California on Wednesday night and Thursday, with Los Angeles warning residents in mudslide-prone areas of potential evacuation orders to come. Southern Californians were also warned of potential coastal flooding, heavy surf, wave damage to coastal piers and parking lots and beach sand erosion. Heavy snow warnings were issued for higher elevations of the Sierra Mountains, including in the Greater Lake Tahoe area. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: “大气河流”席卷加州，旧金山湾区遭遇破纪录降雨
items.summaryZh: 强风暴“大气河流”袭击加州，导致旧金山湾区出现破纪录降雨，引发洪水与停电。南加州地区已发布预警，提醒居民防范泥石流及沿海洪水风险。
items.whyImportant: 极端天气对加州基础设施及居民安全构成严重威胁，并可能引发大规模的应急响应行动。
